title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Brand-Generic Cost Difference: Questions and Answers for Member Services
content:
Training questions and answers on the brand-generic cost difference under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan.

> **Rule.** When the design applies the member brand penalty and the member asks for a brand with an A-rated generic available, the member also pays the brand-generic cost difference. The difference is waived only when the design offers the prescriber DAW 1 waiver and the prescriber marked the prescription dispense-as-written. The difference does not post to out-of-pocket while the design does not count it toward the out-of-pocket maximum.

**Q. What sets off the brand-generic difference?**
A. Two things together: the member's design applies the member brand penalty, and the member asks for a brand drug for which an A-rated generic is available. The member then pays the brand-generic cost difference on top of the cost share.

**Q. When is the difference waived?**
A. Only when both of these hold: the design offers the prescriber DAW 1 waiver, and the prescriber marked the prescription dispense-as-written. If either is missing, the difference is not waived.

**Q. Does the difference count toward the out-of-pocket maximum?**
A. Not while the design's setting is that it does not count. In that case the difference is charged but posts nothing to out-of-pocket.

## Waiver in every combination (design applies the member brand penalty; member asked for the brand; A-rated generic available)

| Design offers the DAW 1 waiver | Prescriber marked dispense-as-written | Brand-generic difference |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Waived |
| Yes | No | Charged |
| No | Yes | Charged |
| No | No | Charged |

## Worked example (hypothetical prices)

On a design that applies the member brand penalty, does not offer the waiver, and does not count the difference toward out-of-pocket, a member asks for a brand whose hypothetical cost is 210.00 where the A-rated generic's cost is 30.00. The brand-generic cost difference is 210.00 less 30.00, which is 180.00. The member pays the cost share plus 180.00, and the 180.00 posts nothing to out-of-pocket.
